Dataset: FAOSTAT crops and livestock products: coffee, green (production, area harvested, yield)
Access_Method: Bulk download (publisher zip, ~34 MB) filtered to the three countries by scripts/ingest/ds01_faostat_yields.py; the query API now requires an authorization header
License_Or_Terms: FAO open data licence - attribution required
Notes: National, not district. Processed file data/processed/ds-01-coffee-national-yields.csv with dictionary. Validated 2026-10-08: units converted once (kg/ha to t/ha), production/area reproduces the published yield within 2 percent in every row. Ethiopia 2023-2024 carry E and I flags (estimated, imputed). Calibrates yield_vol and base_yield_t_ha (data/rt7-calibration.csv).

Dataset: CHIRPS v2.0 monthly precipitation, averaged over the six RT-7 coffee districts inside geoBoundaries polygons
Regions: Colombia-Huila; Colombia-Cauca; Ethiopia-Jimma; Ethiopia-Sidama; Vietnam-Dak Lak; Vietnam-Lam Dong
Source_Organization: Climate Hazards Center, UC Santa Barbara (rainfall); geoBoundaries (boundaries)
Access_Method: IRI Data Library grid table over each district's bounding box (scripts/ingest/ds02_chirps.py), masked to the geoBoundaries gbOpen polygon (commit 9469f09, simplified), which is committed as data/processed/ds-02-district-boundaries.geojson
Variables: precipitation (mm/month), district mean over 0.05-degree cells; calendar-year totals and standardised anomalies
Temporal_Coverage: 1981-01 to the latest CHIRPS month at retrieval
License_Or_Terms: CHIRPS public domain; geoBoundaries gbOpen open licences per country (see NOTICE)
Used_By: RT-7: climate_rain_beta, portfolio_climate_cross_corr, collective_climate_idio_share (via data/rt7-climate-history.csv); EXP-10 index design
Notes: Processed files data/processed/ds-02-district-rainfall-monthly.csv and -annual.csv; data/rt7-climate-history.csv holds the per-region standardised anomaly the model's empirical climate factor bootstraps from. The boundary question is answered by committing the polygons with their shapeIDs. Ethiopia's polygons are the 2016 set (Sidama as a zone). Validated 2026-10-08: see the dictionary's validation block.

Dataset: NASA POWER daily meteorology and solar
Regions: Colombia-Huila; Colombia-Cauca; Ethiopia-Jimma; Ethiopia-Sidama; Vietnam-Dak Lak; Vietnam-Lam Dong
Used_By: RT-7: heat-stress overlay on yield; CapEx solar asset cash flows
Notes: Point requests at district centroids chosen by judgement (coordinates in the query log and the dictionary); 0.5 x 0.625 degree grid, so a regional signal, not a plot. Processed file data/processed/ds-03-district-climate-monthly.csv. Validated 2026-10-08: every point returns every month, mm/day converted to monthly mm by calendar length, no fill values. Used so far only for the observation-only rows in data/rt7-calibration.csv (annual rainfall CV, yield-rain correlation); the climate factor in RT-7 is still a latent draw.

Dataset: World Bank Commodity Price Data (the Pink Sheet): Coffee, Arabica and Coffee, Robusta
Regions: Global (Arabica for Colombia and Ethiopia; Robusta for Vietnam)
Access_Method: XLSX download; the file's doc id changes each release and is read off the landing page (current id in scripts/ingest/ds04_pink_sheet.py)
Variables: monthly nominal USD/kg, Arabica (ICO indicator) and Robusta (ICO indicator)
Notes: Converted USD/kg to USD/t (x1000). World reference prices, not farm-gate; the gap is basis_local, unmeasured. Processed file data/processed/ds-04-coffee-prices-monthly.csv. Validated 2026-10-08: unit read from the header row before conversion, continuous monthly, Arabica above Robusta except three months in 1979. Calibrates price_vol and price_base_usd_per_t; fwd_price_usd_per_t is derived from the base with an assumed discount.

Dataset: ICO coffee indicator prices and Coffee Development Report statistics
Variables: composite and group indicator prices, US cents/lb
Used_By: RT-7: cross-check on DS-04; LIT-035 is the reference read
Notes: LIT-035 documents the 2019/20 range and variability flags.

Dataset: Our World in Data: coffee bean production (derived from FAOSTAT)
Notes: Derived; cite DS-01 as the source of record. Available as a grapher CSV (coffee-yields) and usable as a cross-check on DS-01 when the FAOSTAT bulk file is unreachable.

Dataset: Partner cooperative loan book and repayment history
Source_Organization: Partner (to be identified via the business-research market map)
Variables: loan-level origination and repayment records per RT-1
License_Or_Terms: Confidential - member-level data never enters the repo
Used_By: RT-7: base_pd_*, lgd_*, pd_anchor_dscr, pd_dscr_sensitivity, residual_correlation (via EXP-25)
Notes: Row-level data lives in the Vault. Only aggregates come back. LIT-031 warns cooperative records are often informal.

Dataset: Partner cooperative member register and delivery records
Variables: members, farm area, deliveries by season, share of crop delivered
Used_By: RT-7: n_members, avg_area_ha, area_sd, hedge_ratio_*, member_yield_*, side_sell_*
Notes: LIT-033 shows registers are obtainable through unions and the Cooperatives Agency in Sidama.

Dataset: Exchange rates to USD: Banco de la Republica TRM (COP, daily) and World Bank WDI official rate (COP, ETB, VND, annual)
Source_Organization: Banco de la Republica via datos.gov.co; World Bank
Access_Method: Socrata JSON API (TRM) and World Bank API (WDI PA.NUS.FCRF) by scripts/ingest/ds09_exchange_rates.py
Variables: COP per USD daily averaged to months; LCU per USD annual period average
Temporal_Coverage: COP 2003-01 to 2026-10; annual 2000 to 2025 where published
Used_By: RT-7: converts the Colombian internal price (DS-10) and the literature inputs (data/rt7-literature-inputs.csv) to USD
Notes: Processed file data/processed/ds-09-exchange-rates.csv. Validated 2026-10-08: complete months carry about 20 business-day observations; WDI annual COP agrees with the TRM monthly mean to within 1 percent. Caveat: the 2024 ETB annual average straddles the July 2024 float.

Dataset: FNC coffee statistics workbook: internal base purchase price, ex-dock price, ICO indicators, area by department
Access_Method: XLSX download; the file name carries the month and is read off the statistics page by scripts/ingest/ds10_fnc_colombia.py
Variables: internal price COP per carga of 125 kg dry parchment; ex-dock and ICO prices US cents/lb; cultivated area by department, thousand ha
Temporal_Coverage: Prices 2000-01 to 2026-09 (internal price from 1944 in source); area 2002 to 2025
License_Or_Terms: Published statistics, no licence stated; attribution to FNC
Used_By: RT-7: basis_local (Colombia), Huila and Cauca area shares
Notes: Processed files data/processed/ds-10-colombia-coffee-prices-monthly.csv and ds-10-colombia-coffee-area-by-department.csv. The internal price is quoted at the FNC base yield factor (88 kg parchment per 70 kg excelso until 2024-03, 94 from 2024-04; RES-33, RES-34), so the green-equivalent conversion uses only months from 2024-04. Validated 2026-10-08: ex-dock tracks the ICO Colombian milds indicator within a few cents; department areas sum to the TOTAL row.

Dataset: Kiva agriculture loans, Colombia and Viet Nam, with field-partner portfolio metrics (proxy population)
Access_Method: Public GraphQL API, paged, by scripts/ingest/ds11_kiva_loans.py (3,000 newest Agriculture loans per country, all statuses); borrower names and towns kept in the raw file only
Variables: loan amount USD, term months, status, dates, activity, coffee mention flag, partner id; partner default, arrears and at-risk rates, loans posted
License_Or_Terms: Kiva API terms of use; public loan data
Used_By: RT-7: avg_opex_size and base_pd_opex for Colombia (Basis proxy); Viet Nam observations only
Notes: Processed files data/processed/ds-11-kiva-agriculture-loans.csv (6,000 rows, 603 Colombian and 81 Vietnamese loans mention coffee) and ds-11-kiva-partners.csv (7 partners). Not a cooperative loan book: microfinance partners' Kiva-funded portfolios. The Vietnamese coffee loans all come from one paused partner with 68 percent arrears, so Viet Nam is recorded as observations and not applied. Ethiopia has no Kiva agriculture loans. Validated 2026-10-08: sixteen columns, no names, amounts numeric, partner rates as published.
